set.name: 生豆批次单 · Origin Lot Tag
set.mechanism: 烘焙工坊的生豆批次吊牌（Lot Tag）：以字标笔画裁切与底栏打孔刻度线直接把“半山烘焙”做成一张产地溯源卡，配单字族黑体与生豆翠青色。
set.expression_move: 纯中文字标设计：‘半’字横画的半山断口与底部贯穿的生豆青批次卡尺直接咬合，不设冗余图形。
set.differs_by: 彻底摒弃行业常见的图形徽章，用纯字标定制（wordmark-only）+ 实验室批次卡语言，在浅中烘订阅场景中凸显烘焙日期与处理法数据。

ideas: 批次卡字标：在“半山烘焙”四字下方贯穿生豆批次标尺，并对首字“半”做水平阶梯断口。
半字负空间切口：将“半”字左点与上横切出 45° 山坡角，呼应半山地形。
烘焙时间戳字标：将字标末笔与批次卡圆孔结合，像夹在生豆桶上的金属铭牌。
双语等宽账册：中文粗黑体与英文 BANSHAN 形成上下对齐的实验室封条。
logo.concept: 以重黑体“半山烘焙”为基底，首字“半”右横做批次模具切口，字标下方贯穿四字全宽的水洗生豆青批次标尺与吊牌圆孔。
logo.defect: 将字标底部的批次标尺与圆孔延伸至四字全宽（x=6..542），保留‘半’字左上点改作右横模具切口，并把 16px 小图标重构为宽孔隙批次吊牌以消除小尺寸粘连警告。

rationale.claim: 按照 ai-defaults 规范提供一套纯字标（wordmark-only）方案，并在中文字形轮廓上通过 wordmark_detail_svg 做专属几何裁切与批次标尺。
单字族 Noto Sans SC（800 标题 / 400+600 正文）同时满足中英字符覆盖与默认等宽数字（tnum gate 通过），且零额外字体体积开销。

findings.message: light: link #096d45 on text #1c1c1c is 2.67:1, below 3.0:1 (links distinguishable from body text without underline (WCAG G183); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: success #087868 and accent #1d8558 are only CIEDE2000 10.0 apart; users may read one as the other

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.01, same hue

findings.message: #1d8558 is a mid-lightness trap: white 4.62:1, black 4.55:1; body text on it needs a darker or lighter derivative

suggested_fix.how: keep the brand colour for large areas/logo; put text on a derivative step of its scale

findings.message: light: border #cdd4d2 on background #f1f4f3 is 1.36:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.22, same hue

findings.message: dark: border #414141 on background #0f0f0f is 1.88:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#1d8558 sits at the sRGB gamut edge (92% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
Noto Sans SC lacks English auxiliary/punctuation characters: Ĕ Ĭ Ÿ ĕ ĭ
findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family

findings.message: Noto Sans SC misses 96/319 GF Latin Core codepoints (reach beyond the brief's languages)
findings.suggested_fix: matters only if the brand may add more Latin-script languages

findings.message: Noto Sans SC: ~739 KB WOFF2 for the brief's characters (one variable file, all weights; estimate)
烘焙炭黑 #1c2321 is ΔE2000 8.2 from lacabra.com's primary #34352a
findings.suggested_fix: move lightness or hue until ΔE2000 >= 10, or say why sharing it is deliberate
